subject: english
stem: Which answer is supported by the passage that includes “A city discovered part of an ancient wall during subway construction.”?
options: Archaeologists studied old cooking tools and plant remains to understand what people ate long ago.
A farmer found an old coin in a field and gave it to a museum.
Historians studied it and found that it showed how the old city had protected itself.
A teacher showed students an old version of a popular website from many years ago.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「Archaeologists studied old cooking tools and plant remains to understand what people ate long ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「A farmer found an old coin in a field and gave it to a museum.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「Historians studied it and found that it showed how the old city had protected itself.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「A teacher showed students an old version of a popular website from many years ago.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「Historians studied it and found that it showed how the old city had protected itself.」，答案為「Historians studied it and found that it showed how the old city had protected itself.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「Historians studied it and found that it showed how the old city had protected itself.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
